name: field-break-upset
title: Field-break UpSet plot
description: UpSet plot showing which fields break together across records, with combination frequencies and per-field totals.
needs: Comparable fields where breaks can be identified across records.

text.lede: A break is rarely one field. Each column is a combination of fields that break together: the dots say which fields, the bar says how many {unit}. A tall bar on a pair of fields is one cause producing many breaks.
text.chartSub: Paired {unit} with at least one break. The bars at the left count every break in that field. Select a column.
